role: operational authorized raw-data materialization only; no scientific model fitting
download_scope: all GPS events within each full calendar year; no spring-only truncation at raw-materialization stage
rationale: movepp phase classification requires unbiased annual context; seasonal restriction occurs only in frozen downstream preprocessing

authentication.method: MOVEBANK_API_TOKEN environment variable / GitHub secret only

license.required_user_state: authorized account must have accepted any required terms in Movebank before workflow execution
license.terms_page_behavior: fail closed and write BLOCKED manifest

execution_boundary: successful materialization opens raw movement events but does not open the preregistered cue-uptake coefficient or threshold result
next_gate: run frozen movepp preprocessing only after exact/source-backed route geometry is materialized; do not analyze cue-uptake model before geometry gate
